name: doc_template_fill
description: Fill {{placeholders}} (with optional {{field|default}}) in plain text or in a Word .docx given as hex, with no package: the .docx is opened as a zip and the text runs of the body, headers, footers, notes and comments are rewritten, joining the runs of each paragraph so a placeholder Word split across runs is still found. Returns the filled text or .docx (hex), the paragraph texts, and the placeholders found, missing and defaulted.

output.text: Hello Ana, your order 1042 ships soon.

catalog.source: ECMA-376 Office Open XML, Part 1 section 17.3 (paragraphs, runs and text); approach after docxtpl (elapouya/python-docx-template), stdlib zipfile only
